objective_pt: Fazer uma reclamação formal e pedir reembolso ou troca, e também atender um cliente insatisfeito com educação.

teacher.goal_pt: Contar experiências boas e ruins com atendimento e ver como o aluno fala de problemas com produtos.
prompts: Tell me about a bad customer service experience.
Do you prefer to call or to chat online?

exercises.prompt: Hi, I'm calling about an order I placed last week.
accepted: Hi, I'm calling about an order I placed last week.
Hi, I am calling about an order I placed last week.
Hello, I'm calling about an order I placed last week.

exercises.explanation_pt: "Reclamation" é recuperação (de terra, de material). "Reclamação" é "complaint", e "reclamar" é "complain".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eu gostaria de fazer uma reclamação."
accepted: I'd like to make a complaint
I would like to make a complaint
I want to make a complaint
I'd like to file a complaint
I'd like to complain about something
I'd like to complain
I'd like to make a formal complaint
I'd like to report a problem

commonErrors.correction_en: I'd like to make a complaint.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Fazer uma reclamação" é "make a complaint", não "do".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'd like to make a complaint.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender vocabulário de atendimento: refund, replacement, faulty, look into, escalate, on hold.
prompts: Have you ever asked for a refund?
How long were you on hold the last time you called a company?
watchFor: Dizer "the product came broken"; o natural é "it arrived damaged" ou "it's faulty".
Pronunciar "refund" com tônica no fim quando é substantivo; o substantivo é RE-fund.

exercises.example_en: I'd like a full refund, please.
The charger was faulty, so I sent it back.
I'll look into it and call you back today.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Say it in English: "O produto chegou com defeito e eu quero meu dinheiro de volta."
accepted: The product arrived faulty and I'd like my money back
The product arrived damaged and I'd like a refund
The product was faulty and I'd like a refund
The product arrived faulty and I want my money back
The product arrived damaged and I want my money back
The product was defective and I'd like my money back
The product arrived defective and I'd like a refund
The product doesn't work and I'd like a refund
The item arrived damaged and I'd like a refund
It arrived faulty and I'd like a refund

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Chegou com defeito" fica mais natural como "arrived faulty", "arrived damaged" ou "was defective".
commonErrors.correction_en: The product arrived faulty and I'd like a refund.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Devolução" de dinheiro é "refund"; de produto, "return". "Devolution" é transferência de poder político.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar o tom educado e firme e a pronúncia de "receipt" (o "p" é mudo).
prompts: How do you sound polite but firm?
watchFor: Terminar frases com o tom subindo, como se não tivesse certeza do pedido.

exercises.prompt: I still have the receipt, if you need it.
accepted: I still have the receipt, if you need it.
I've still got the receipt, if you need it.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat politely. Let your voice go down at the end.
exercises.prompt: I was wondering if you could send me a replacement.
accepted: I was wondering if you could send me a replacement.
I was wondering whether you could send me a replacement.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I was wondering if..." combina com "could": é mais educado e soa natural.
commonErrors.correction_en: I was wondering if you could send me a replacement.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which word also has a silent letter?
exercises.explanation_pt: Em "debt" o "b" é mudo ("dét"), como o "p" de "receipt". Em "debit" o "b" é pronunciado.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender o que o atendente oferece e responder como cliente, de forma clara.
prompts: What would you say if they put you on hold for too long?
What information do they usually ask for?
watchFor: Responder o número do pedido letra por letra sem agrupar.
Não entender "Can I put you on hold?".

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. What is the agent going to do?
exercises.listen: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll arrange a replacement, and you'll get it within three working days.
options: Transfer the call to a manager
exercises.explanation_pt: "Arrange a replacement" é providenciar a troca, um produto novo.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. Ask for a refund instead of a replacement.
exercises.listen: We can send you a new one, or is there anything else we can do for you?
accepted: I'd prefer a refund, please
I'd rather have a refund
I'd rather get a refund
Actually, I'd prefer a refund
Actually, I'd like a refund
I'd like a refund instead
I'd like a refund, please
Could I get a refund instead?
Could I have a refund instead?
I'd prefer my money back
I'd rather have my money back
I'd like my money back, please

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Receber o dinheiro de volta" é "get my money back" ou simplesmente "a refund".
Depois de "I'd rather" o verbo vem sem "to": "I'd rather have a refund".

exercises.instruction_pt: You are the agent now. Listen and respond with empathy.
exercises.listen: This is the third time I've called about this problem, and nobody has helped me!
accepted: I'm really sorry to hear that. Let me look into it for you
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into it
I'm so sorry about that. I'll look into it right away
I completely understand. Let me see what I can do
I understand your frustration. Let me look into it
I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Let me check what happened
I apologize for that. I'll sort it out for you now
I'm really sorry. I'll make sure it gets solved today
I'm sorry about that. Let me see what I can do
I understand, and I'm sorry. I'll look into it now

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "I'm sorry to hear that", com "to".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Verificar" um problema é "look into it". "Look for" é procurar algo perdido.
commonErrors.correction_en: Let me look into it for you.

teacher.goal_pt: Simular uma ligação: o aluno explica o problema, responde às perguntas e negocia uma solução. Depois trocar os papéis.
prompts: Thank you for calling. How can I help you today?
Could I have your order number, please?
Would you like a replacement or a refund?
watchFor: Usar "attend" para atender ("the attendant didn't attend me"); é "help", "serve" ou "answer the phone".
Ser direto demais ("I want..."); incentivar "I'd like..." e "Could you...?".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ninguém me atendeu na loja."
accepted: Nobody helped me at the store
Nobody helped me in the store
No one helped me at the store
No one served me at the store
Nobody served me in the shop
Nobody served me at the shop
Nobody came to help me at the store
Nobody assisted me at the store
Nobody attended to me at the store

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Atender" um cliente é "help", "serve" ou "attend to". "Attend me" não funciona.
commonErrors.correction_en: Nobody helped me at the store.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês não usamos dupla negação: "Nobody helped me", e não "Nobody didn't help me".
commonErrors.correction_en: Nobody helped me at the store.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eu vou verificar e te ligo de volta em uma hora."
accepted: I'll look into it and call you back in an hour
I'll check and call you back in an hour
I'll look into it and get back to you in an hour
I'll check and get back to you in an hour
I'll check it and call you back within an hour
Let me look into it and I'll call you back in an hour
I'll look into this and call you back in an hour
I'm going to check and call you back in an hour
I'll check on it and call you back in an hour

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Verify" é confirmar se algo é verdade, mais formal. Para "vou verificar", o natural é "I'll check" ou "I'll look into it".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll look into it and call you back in an hour.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com pronome, ele fica no meio: "call you back".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll call you back in an hour.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Daqui a uma hora" é "in an hour". "After an hour" é "depois de passar uma hora" (num relato).
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll call you back in an hour.

exercises.instruction_pt: Put the words in order to make a polite request.
accepted: Could you tell me when I can expect the refund

exercises.instruction_pt: Call customer service. Your new headphones stopped working after a week. Explain and ask for a solution.
exercises.prompt_en: Good afternoon, thanks for calling. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
guidelines_pt: Explain the problem: "I bought... last week and..."
Say what you want politely: "I'd like a refund" or "Could you send me a replacement?"
Ask about next steps: "How long will it take?"

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar os pedidos educados e os falsos cognatos "reclamation", "devolution" e "attend".
prompts: How do you ask for a refund politely?
What does a good agent say to an angry customer?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Você poderia me transferir para um gerente?"
accepted: Could you transfer me to a manager?
Could you put me through to a manager?
Can you transfer me to a manager?
Can you put me through to a manager?
Could I speak to a manager?
Could I speak to a manager, please?
Could you transfer me to a manager, please?
Would you transfer me to a manager, please?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Transferimos alguém "to" uma pessoa: "transfer me to a manager".
commonErrors.correction_en: Could you transfer me to a manager?
Could you transfer me to a manager?

exercises.sentence: Thank you for your patience. I'll look ___ it right away.
accepted: into

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para investigar um problema, o phrasal verb é "look into".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll look into it right away.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which is the most polite request?
options: I was wondering if you could help me with my order.
You must help me with my order.
exercises.explanation_pt: "I was wondering if you could..." é um pedido indireto e muito educado.

exercises.prompt: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
accepted: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Is there anything else I can help you with?
